# Colab GPU for Orca (orca-colab)

> Colab GPU for Orca is an Orca plugin and command-line tool that lets Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents run jobs on Google Colab GPUs (T4, L4, A100) from the user's own Colab account. The agent starts a runtime, syncs the workspace, runs training, fine-tuning or inference jobs with live logs, pulls results back and releases the runtime. Code, agents and credentials stay on the user's machine; everything goes over HTTPS to the Colab API (no SSH, VPN or notebook). Free and open source (MIT); a community project, not affiliated with Google. Listed in the Orca plugin directory as "Colab GPU (Community) for Orca".

## Install and use
- [Orca plugin directory listing](https://orca.dev/plugins/vzxxbacq/orca-colab): install in Orca, then sign in with Google in the Colab GPU panel
- [README](https://github.com/vzxxbacq/orca-colab#readme): quick start, FAQ, CLI overview
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/vzxxbacq/orca-colab/blob/main/skills/colab-gpu/references/cli.md): every command, flag and exit code
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/vzxxbacq/orca-colab/blob/main/skills/colab-gpu/SKILL.md): the procedure agents follow (`npx skills add vzxxbacq/orca-colab`)
